title: Forearm Mobility - B
texts:
Complete 4 sets total of wrist rolls mixed up the directions per set.
Wrist rolls should be gentle and slow focusing on moving in a large range of motion in both directions. 
Roll your wrists for 20 seconds per set with 20 seconds rest between sets.

Complete 8 sets total (4 on each arm) of each static stretch
Stretches should be held in the most stretched position possible where you feel slight discomfort but not pain.  
You will have 30 seconds to rest each side as you stretch the other hand. 
10 seconds is given to shake out between hands. 

To maintain flexibility in your forearms, each position should be held for 30 seconds.
